# Semantic failure clusters

::: {.hub-idea-hero}
<p class="hub-idea-status">Idea · Medium priority · 2/9 readiness fields complete</p>

## What does this mean?

Group similar ranking failures to find request types where a method repeatedly struggles.
:::

## Why does it matter?

Recurring failure patterns could show where a ranking method needs a different evidence strategy or should not be used.

## How does it work?

<ol class="hub-process hub-record-path">
<li class="hub-process-step">Represent development failures using bounded query and ranking evidence.</li>
<li class="hub-process-step">Cluster similar failures and describe the resulting query types.</li>
<li class="hub-process-step">Test whether the clusters predict weakness on a held-out development partition.</li>
</ol>

## What do we know?

Clustering can describe repeated failures, but a useful test still needs a
falsifiable hypothesis and a boundary that prevents tuning on evaluation
labels.

## What is missing?

- Hypothesis
- Decision rule
- Evaluation boundary
- Artifact plan

## What happens next?

State a falsifiable hypothesis and evaluation boundary for the clustering test.
